query: INSERT INTO tabac_molecule_links (tabac_id, molecule_id, concentration, notes, created_at) SELECT t.id, m.id, 0.85, 'Compose phenolique du Kentucky fire-cured', NOW() FROM tabacs t, molecules m WHERE t.name LIKE '%Kentucky%' AND m.name LIKE '%guaiacol%' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE notes = VALUES(notes); INSERT INTO tabac_molecule_links (tabac_id, molecule_id, concentration, notes, created_at) SELECT t.id, m.id, 0.7, 'Terpene boise du Kentucky', NOW() FROM tabacs t, molecules m WHERE t.name LIKE '%Kentucky%' AND m.name LIKE '%pinene%' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE notes = VALUES(notes);
